steps: Inspect the harness and connectors for a loose contact.
Check whether readings remain stable after securing the connection.
props.title: Inspect the loose connection

steps: Check SDA and SCL at the controller and attached devices.
Reinitialize the bus and verify replies from each device.
props.title: Inspect the I2C bus

props.risk: Interrupts every load on the rail.
steps: Check the supply and connections upstream of the rail.
Confirm output is stable before restoring attached loads.
props.title: Inspect the power rail

steps: Check the radio power and the UART connection.
Confirm heartbeat frames resume at the receiver.
props.title: Inspect the UART link

steps: Inspect the bus with the suspect device isolated.
Check that each device can reply before returning the segment to service.
props.title: Isolate the affected I2C segment

steps: Inspect the input supply and regulator wiring on the bench.
Once output is stable, reinitialize the affected drivers.
props.title: Restore regulator power

steps: Inspect the device's power and data connector.
Reinitialize the device and verify its readings.
props.title: Check the device and harness

steps: Check the sensor against a known input.
Reinitialize it and check whether its readings change.
props.title: Check the sensor output

steps: Inspect the driver logs and restart the affected driver.
Confirm the channel meets its sampling period again.
props.title: Restart the sampler driver
